in_hebrew.name: Baggett
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Little bag, bundle
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Baggett הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'beorhtget,' meaning 'bright one with a little bag.' This name may have originally referred to someone who carried a small bag, perhaps of tools or provisions. In a spiritual context, it can symbolize carrying the light of God within.
